critical.description: At or below this percent, on battery, the tile turns red.

low.description: At or below this percent, on battery, the tile turns yellow.

sample.description:
Read this instead of the machine: a file with saved `pmset -g batt`
output, or a folder laid out like `/sys/class/power_supply`. For tests
and demos.

entries.description: Battery charge as a gauge, with the power source and the time left (or to full). Reads pmset on macOS and /sys/class/power_supply on Linux.
entries.name: Battery
